quotes: The South Ukraine Nuclear Power Plant reported air raid alarms on a near daily basis and detected one drone within its monitoring area late last week as well as five early this morning.

The Chornobyl site also continued to report air raid alarms on a near daily basis, with a noticeable increase over the past weekend, and detected four drones within its monitoring area over the past week.
The Khmelnytskyy Nuclear Power Plant reported detecting one unmanned aerial vehicle within its monitoring zone over the past week, and the team had to shelter on-site today due to an air raid alarm.
